title: Crypto Cubes
tagline: Crypto cubes is on chain puzzle game with interactive NFT collectibles.
description: Crypto Cubes is a game for crypto enthusiasts where you can solve the puzzle to increase the value of NFTs collectibles in 3D space. Crypto Cubes NFT are randomly pre-mixed and minted on the blockchain. Successful problem solvers will get 3D printed utility token representing their NFT collectible.
how_its_made: We used Three.js and react for 3D puzzle, that would be randomized when either hosted and minted Ethereum blockchain. 3D representation is stored as IPFS. Project is currently in look for Solidity developer. Potential minting NFT on OpenSea. We crated mockup was made in Adobe Illustrator.
